tasks.label: Run RSVP iOS Simulator
tasks.command: device_id=$(xcrun simctl list devices available | awk -F '[()]' '/\(Booted\)/ {print $2; exit}'); if [ -z "$device_id" ]; then device_id=$(xcrun simctl list devices available | awk -F '[()]' '/iPhone 17 Pro \(/ {print $2; exit}'); xcrun simctl boot "$device_id"; open -a Simulator; sleep 5; fi; xcrun simctl install "$device_id" bin/Debug/net10.0-ios/iossimulator-arm64/RSVPProject.app && xcrun simctl launch --terminate-running-process "$device_id" com.companyname.rsvpproject
